newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 2.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 32.51 points lower at 6,976.48 as investors braced for Friday's key jobs report for April.

* Sixteen new Indonesian stocks including Asahimas were included in the Morgan Stanley Capital Index, while eight Indonesian stocks which had been in the index were deleted. The index is used as benchmark by many fund managers.
* On Thursday, the composite index fell 1.60 points to close at 650.46 points.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,433.50/34.00 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,434.50/35.00.
* BNI, Asahimas, Bimantara, Citra Marga and Gudang Garam following reports on the new composition of Morgan Stanley Capital Index (MSCI).
* Bank Bira and Ciputra Development on reports of a link-up between the Bira Group and the Ciputra Group to build a large property project in Jakarta.
* Petrochemical firm Tri Polyta on reports the firm was studying the possibility of a merger with its affiliated supplier PT Chandra Asri.
* Astra on a newspaper report the automobile conglomerate planned to produce sedans priced between 35 million to 40 million rupiah each.
